GXO expands Digit agreement to two more US sites for early 2027

The expansion covers Statesville and Lebanon, beginning with Digit 4 and moving to Digit 5 when commercially available.

Agility Robotics ↗26 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

Two additional fulfillment sites

GXO and Agility announced an expanded agreement on October 26 for repetitive material handling at e-commerce sites in Statesville, North Carolina, and Lebanon, Tennessee. Deployments are expected in early 2027; these are planned additions, not sites already operating Digit.

Building on the existing service

The Flowery Branch, Georgia, operation began a Robots-as-a-Service agreement in 2024, combining tote-to-conveyor work with Agility Arc fleet integration. The companies report over 100,000 totes moved there cumulatively. That is historical output at the existing site, not throughput or results from the new locations.

A staged hardware transition

The new sites will begin with Digit 4 and migrate to Digit 5 when it becomes commercially available. Robot counts, contract value and payback are undisclosed. Expansion by an existing customer signals adoption, while operators still need to assess safety and economics for their own workflows.
